by
  have hsum := summable_deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTermLp ha h
  have hcoeSum := MeasureTheory.Lp.coeFn_tsum
    ((tsum_enorm_ne_top_iff_summable_norm).2

  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (fun x : ℝ => (deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTermLp h n a) x) =ᵐ[volume]
        (fun x : ℝ => deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTerm h |x| n a) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : 0 < n
    · filter_upwards [
        MeasureTheory.Lp.coeFn_smul (deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeScalar n a)
          (deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilationLp h n hn),
        Integrable.coeFn_toL1
          (deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilation_integrable h hn)] with x hx hy
      have hy' : (deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilationLp h n hn) x =
          deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilation h n x := by
        change ((deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilation_integrable h hn).toL1
          (deningerAdiabaticEvenLogPullDilation h n)) x = _
        exact hy
      rw [deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTermLp, dif_pos hn, hx]
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
      rw [hy']
      rfl
    · have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
      subst n
      filter_upwards with x
      simp [deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTermLp,
        deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTerm]
  have htermAll : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ n : ℕ,
      (deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTermLp h n a) x =
        deningerAdiabaticMobiusDerivativeTerm h |x| n a :=
    eventually_countable_forall.2 hterm
  filter_upwards [hcoeSum, htermAll] with x hsumx hterms
  rw [deningerAdiabaticEulerPositiveLp, hsumx,
    deningerAdiabaticMobiusParameterDerivative]
  exact tsum_congr hterms

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hG1ne : zetaResidueUnit 1 ≠ 0 := by rw [zetaResidueUnit_one]; norm_num
  have hlogGcont : ContinuousAt (logDeriv zetaResidueUnit) 1 :=
    (zetaResidueUnit_analyticAt.deriv.continuousAt).div zetaResidueUnit_analyticAt.continuousAt hG1ne
  have hEq : (fun s => -deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s - 1 / (s - 1)) =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)]
      fun s => -logDeriv zetaResidueUnit s := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, nhdsWithin_le_nhds zetaResidueUnit_ne_zero_eventually]
      with s hs hGs
    have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := hs
    have hlog : -deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s = -logDeriv zetaResidueUnit s + (s - 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [neg_div, ← logDeriv_apply, logDeriv_zeta_eq hs1 hGs]; ring
    rw [hlog]; ring
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun s => -logDeriv zetaResidueUnit s) (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ))
      (𝓝 (-logDeriv zetaResidueUnit 1)) :=
    hlogGcont.neg.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  rw [logDeriv_zetaResidueUnit_one] at hlim
  exact (tendsto_congr' hEq).mpr hlim

/-- **The residue of `-ζ'/ζ` at a zeta zero `ρ ≠ 1` is `-m(ρ)`**, where `m(ρ) ≥ 1` is the analytic
multiplicity of the zero: `(s-ρ)·(-ζ'/ζ)(s) → -m`.  Obtained by factoring `ζ = (z-ρ)^m·g` near `ρ`
(`g` analytic, `g(ρ) ≠ 0`, from the removable/order structure of the analytic `ζ` on the connected set
`{1}ᶜ`, using that `ζ` is not identically zero since `ζ(2) ≠ 0`) and applying
`logDeriv_residue_of_factorization`.  This turns each off-critical zeta zero into a pole of the
prime–polar continuation with residue proportional to its multiplicity. -/

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rintro ⟨R, hcompleted⟩
  have hden := polynomial_eval_ofReal_eventually_ne_zero R.denom (RatFunc.denom_ne_zero R)
  have heuler :
      (fun x : ℝ => finiteTranslationAction twoStepTranslationOperator
        (iteratedDeriv 1 eulerLogDerivative) x) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ => RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℂ) (x : ℂ)
        (completedZetaEulerDefectRatFunc R)) := by
    filter_upwards [hcompleted, hden, eventually_gt_atTop (2 : ℝ)] with x hcomp hxden hx
    rw [twoStepTranslation_eulerDerivative_eq_archimedean_sub_completed hx, hcomp,
      completedZetaEulerDefectRatFunc_eval R hx hxden]
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (eventually_atTop.1 heuler)
  let sigma : ℝ := max B 2 + 1
  have hsigma : 1 < sigma := by dsimp [sigma]; linarith [le_max_right B 2]
  have htau (x : ℝ) (hx : finiteTranslationThreshold twoStepTranslationOperator sigma ≤ x) :
      B ≤ x := by
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ h ∈ twoStepTranslationOperator.coeff.support, |h.re| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun h hh => abs_nonneg h.re
    have hsigma_le : sigma ≤ finiteTranslationThreshold twoStepTranslationOperator sigma := by
      dsimp [finiteTranslationThreshold]
      linarith
    have hBsigma : B ≤ sigma := by
      dsimp [sigma]
      linarith [le_max_left B 2]
    exact hBsigma.trans (hsigma_le.trans hx)
  have hzero := (eulerLogDerivative_iterated_rationalizes_iff_eq_zero
    1 hsigma twoStepTranslationOperator).mp ⟨completedZetaEulerDefectRatFunc R, fun x hx =>
      hB x (htau x hx)⟩
  exact twoStepTranslationOperator_ne_zero hzero

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let f := GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.shiftedEulerCoeff n
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    unfold GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.shiftedEulerCoeff
    fun_prop
  have han : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 :=
    GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.analyticAt_of_differentiable_univariate hdiff 0
  have hdcomplex : HasDerivAt (deriv f) (iteratedDeriv 2 f 0) 0 := by
    have hraw := han.deriv.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hiter : iteratedDeriv 2 f 0 = deriv (deriv f) 0 := by
      norm_num [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    rw [hiter]
    exact hraw
  have hdreal := hdcomplex.comp_ofReal
  have hre := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hdreal
  have htwo := GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.iteratedDeriv_two_shiftedEulerCoeff n
  change HasDerivAt (fun ω : ℝ => (deriv f (ω : ℂ)).re) _ 0
  have hre' : HasDerivAt (fun ω : ℝ => (deriv f (ω : ℂ)).re)
      (iteratedDeriv 2 f 0).re 0 := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hre
  have htwof : iteratedDeriv 2 f 0 =
      4 * (((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt *
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt) n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [f] using htwo
  rw [htwof] at hre'
  norm_num at hre'
  exact hre'
